payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the performance differences between LM-Base and CGExpan on user-generated datasets, highlighting specific factors that contribute to LM-Base's improved performance.

claims.text: LM-Base outperforms CGExpan on user-generated text due to its ability to handle vague and multifaceted entities better than CGExpan, which penalizes such entities.
Simpler baseline methods like LM-Base perform better on user-generated text benchmarks compared to state-of-the-art methods like CGExpan, which do not generalize well to these datasets.
The performance of SOTA methods like CGExpan drops significantly on user-generated text due to their reliance on well-curated benchmarks that do not reflect the challenges of user-generated content.
